tickets.subject: Export invoices to Tally
tickets.body: We reconcile in Tally Prime. Can Ledgerly export invoices as Tally XML so our accountant doesn't retype them every month?

tickets.subject: Password reset email not arriving
tickets.body: Tried three times this morning, no email.
tickets.resolution: Found in the customer's spam folder (their mail filter flags our reset links). Asked them to allowlist no-reply@ledgerly.example.

tickets.subject: Invoice PDF shows ₹100,000.00 instead of ₹1,00,000.00
tickets.body: Our CA says the invoice amount formatting is wrong for Indian invoices. Lakhs should be grouped as 1,00,000.
tickets.fixed_in_commit: fix: format_inr uses Indian digit grouping (1,00,000)

tickets.subject: GST on our invoice is 1 paisa off from Tally
tickets.body: Our invoice has two SMS pack lines of ₹1.25 each. Ledgerly shows GST ₹0.46, Tally computes ₹0.45 on the total. Which is right?
tickets.last_reply: Ledgerly rounds GST per line, half-up, as the GST portal does. Tally is set to round on the invoice total. Both are allowed; per-line is what we file.

tickets.subject: Payment reminder not sent for invoice due today
tickets.body: Our client's invoice was due yesterday and they say they never got a reminder email. The ones due in 2-3 days do get them.
tickets.fixed_in_commit: fix: payment reminders include invoices due today

tickets.subject: App timing out for several minutes after 2 PM
tickets.body: From about 2:02 PM the invoice list and the dashboard kept spinning and then showed 'Gateway timeout'. Creating an invoice also failed once. Fine again by 2:10.

tickets.subject: Dashboard didn't load around 2:05 PM
tickets.body: Got a 504 on the dashboard twice, works now.

tickets.subject: Billing console: creating an invoice fails (500) for customers on Net 45
tickets.body: We moved Sharma Traders (1042) and Nair Textiles (1063) to Net 45 on Monday as per their new contracts. Since then every invoice I create for them fails with 'Something went wrong (500)'. Customers on Net 15 are fine. I tried at 4:41 and 4:43 PM for Sharma Traders (seat upgrade, 12 to 20 seats) and at 4:52 PM for Nair Textiles. Need this working before month-end close on the 30th.

tickets.subject: How do I add a second GSTIN for our Kolkata branch?
tickets.body: We opened a branch in Kolkata and have a separate GSTIN there.
